poisoned.name: POISONED
poisoned.effect: 1d4 damage each turn. Body save to shake it off.

burning.name: BURNING
burning.effect: 1d6 damage each turn. Reflex save to put it out.

bleeding.name: BLEEDING
bleeding.effect: 2 damage each turn until you are healed.

stunned.name: STUNNED
stunned.effect: You lose your next turn. Attacks on you have advantage.

asleep.name: ASLEEP
asleep.effect: Helpless. Attacks hit automatically until you are hurt.

feared.name: FEARED
feared.effect: You cannot attack in melee. Mind save to steady yourself.

paralyzed.name: PARALYZED
paralyzed.effect: Helpless, and pain will not wake you. Body save.

weakened.name: WEAKENED
weakened.effect: Half weapon damage until you rest.

drained.name: DRAINED
drained.effect: A level's worth of HP gone. The Temple can undo it.

grabbed.name: GRABBED
grabbed.effect: You cannot flee. Hit what holds you.

knockedDown.name: KNOCKED DOWN
knockedDown.effect: −2 DEF, and your next attack is at disadvantage.

webbed.name: WEBBED
webbed.effect: You cannot attack or flee. Break free, or burn it away.

sickened.name: SICKENED
sickened.effect: Disadvantage on your attacks until the round ends.

petrified.name: PETRIFIED
petrified.effect: Helpless, but stone takes less: DR 5.

hidden.name: HIDDEN
hidden.effect: They attack you at disadvantage. Your next strike is a backstab.

combat.grit: You tear yourself free and act.

illegal.badTarget: That one is out of reach.
illegal.noEscape: There is no way past them.

combat.hiddenEnds: You step back into the light.
combat.telegraph: It winds up for something heavy.

sellsword.name: SELLSWORD
sellsword.blurb: Paid to fight, and good at it.

pilgrim.name: PILGRIM
pilgrim.blurb: Walks towards what others run from.

modes.ironmanHint: One life. One save. Death is final.

create.title: ROLL HERO
create.swapPick: Tap another attribute to swap with {name}
create.name: NAME

power_strike.name: POWER STRIKE
power_strike.effect: Melee attack at −2 to hit; one extra weapon die of damage.

brute_force.name: BRUTE FORCE
brute_force.effect: +3 per rank to bash. R2: a chest never breaks, and the noise check drops to 1-in-6.

cleave.name: CLEAVE
cleave.effect: Drop a front-row enemy and attack another for free, once a turn.

armor_training.name: ARMOR TRAINING
armor_training.effect: R1: no penalty in heavy armor. R2: DR 1 in heavy armor.

shield_bash.name: SHIELD BASH
shield_bash.effect: 1d4 + MIG with a shield; Body save or Stunned for 1 round.

riposte.name: RIPOSTE
riposte.effect: When a melee attack misses you, counterattack at once.

second_wind.name: SECOND WIND
second_wind.effect: Heal a quarter of your hit points. Once per combat.

weapon_mastery.name: WEAPON MASTERY
weapon_mastery.effect: One weapon group: +1 critical range, and criticals deal triple.

juggernaut.name: JUGGERNAUT
juggernaut.effect: The Attack action makes two attacks.

sneak.name: SNEAK
sneak.effect: Surprise enemies on a 1 or 2, not just a 1.

lockpicking.name: LOCKPICKING
lockpicking.effect: +2 per rank to pick. R2: picks never break. R3: picking takes 1 step.

trapfinding.name: TRAPFINDING
trapfinding.effect: +2 per rank to find and disarm traps. R2: no passive penalty. R3: salvage by 5.

backstab.name: BACKSTAB
backstab.effect: +2 weapon dice against a Surprised, Stunned, Asleep or Blinded target.

evasion.name: EVASION
evasion.effect: +1 DEF per rank. R2: a made Reflex save against an area effect takes nothing.

envenom.name: ENVENOM
envenom.effect: Your next hit this combat Poisons.

nimble_fingers.name: NIMBLE FINGERS
nimble_fingers.effect: Disarming takes 1 step, and a near miss is only a failure.

vanish.name: VANISH
vanish.effect: Flee, or slip away Hidden. Once per combat.

lucky.name: LUCKY
lucky.effect: Once per combat, force one d20 to be rolled again.

death_strike.name: DEATH STRIKE
death_strike.effect: A helpless target makes a Body save or dies. A boss takes triple damage.

magic_missile.name: MAGIC MISSILE
magic_missile.effect: Never misses. 1d4+1 a missile, one more every four levels.

lore.name: LORE
lore.effect: Identify what you find, read a monster, and see magical traps for what they are.

knock.name: KNOCK
knock.effect: Opens a Simple or Good lock. Out of combat.

sleep.name: SLEEP
sleep.effect: One row: Mind save or Asleep. Undead are immune.

frost_shard.name: FROST SHARD
frost_shard.effect: 2d6 + INT cold; Reflex save or Slowed.

dispel_ward.name: DISPEL WARD
dispel_ward.effect: Opens a Sealed lock or disarms an Arcane trap, at +4.

arcane_shield.name: ARCANE SHIELD
arcane_shield.effect: +4 DEF against a hit that has just landed.

fireball.name: FIREBALL
fireball.effect: 1d6 a level to one whole row; Reflex save for half.

blink.name: BLINK
blink.effect: For 3 rounds, every attack on you may simply miss.

archmage.name: ARCHMAGE
archmage.effect: Spells cost 1 less. Once per combat, cast one free.

keen_senses.name: KEEN SENSES
keen_senses.effect: +3 per rank to find things. R2: you cannot be surprised, and you are warned.

forager.name: FORAGER
forager.effect: Rations last twice as long, and a fight may leave a healing herb.

turn_undead.name: TURN UNDEAD
turn_undead.effect: Undead make a Mind save or flee; the weakest are destroyed.

regeneration.name: REGENERATION
regeneration.effect: Heal 1 HP at the start of your turn, and as you walk.

spirit_ward.name: SPIRIT WARD
spirit_ward.effect: Damage reduction 3 for the rest of the fight.

smite.name: SMITE
smite.effect: +WIT to hit and +2d6 damage; double against undead and demons.

undying.name: UNDYING
undying.effect: Once per rest, a killing blow leaves you at half your hit points.

duelist.name: DUELIST
duelist.effect: Light weapons use AGI. +1 DEF with no shield.

spellblade.name: SPELLBLADE
spellblade.effect: On a melee hit, spend up to 3 Focus for 1d6 damage each.

crusader.name: CRUSADER
crusader.effect: Heal 2 HP whenever your melee attack hits.

arcane_trickster.name: ARCANE TRICKSTER
arcane_trickster.effect: Damage spells get Backstab dice while you are Hidden.

ranger.name: RANGER
ranger.effect: Hunter’s Mark: +2 to hit and +1d6. Your arrows ignore cover.

mystic.name: MYSTIC
mystic.effect: Overhealing becomes temporary HP. Damage spells heal you a quarter.
